cells.gaps: No source found of a law setting a condition on sending personal data in general abroad, or of a ratification of the Malabo Convention.
cells.note: Rescored under Bill's ruling of 2026-10-31 (messages-for-bill 58): The one transfer rule held covers subscribers' registration information only [SLE-001], so it sets no stage for personal data in general. Signature of the Malabo Convention [SLE-002] is not a ratification.
